description: Choice between related alternatives shown in a segmented control.

howToUse: Use it to switch between two to five views or modes of the same content: day, week and month; list and grid.
Keep labels short and of similar length. With `iconOnly`, the labels become the accessible names and tooltips.
Give the group a `label` that names what changes ("Period").
alternatives: Several options on at once: ToggleGroup.
Separate sections with different content: Tabs.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the selected option.
Selects the previous or next option.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Icons only; text labels become accessible names and tooltips.

import { Segmented } from '@refy-design/web';
import type { ComponentProps } from 'react';
export function Example() {
  const args: Pick<
    ComponentProps<typeof Segmented>,
    'label' | 'iconOnly' | 'sliding' | 'defaultValue' | 'options'
  > = {
    label: 'Device',
    iconOnly: true,
    sliding: true,
    defaultValue: 'desktop',
    options: [
      {
        value: 'desktop',
        label: 'Desktop',
        icon: (
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.7"
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="12" rx="2" />
            <path d="M8 21h8M12 16v5" />
          </svg>
        ),
      },
      {
        value: 'tablet',
        label: 'Tablet',
        icon: (
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.7"
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="18" rx="2" />
            <path d="M11 17h2" />
          </svg>
        ),
      },
      {
        value: 'mobile',
        label: 'Phone',
        icon: (
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.7"
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <rect x="6" y="2" width="12" height="20" rx="2" />
            <path d="M11 18h2" />
          </svg>
        ),
      },
    ],
  };
  return <Segmented {...args} />;
}
